name: living-credit-v1
question: Can the same 163-weight Chuck acquire measured consequences in its current training life, and does the action-to-outcome association change that life?

input_life.reason: The previous parent-state refit improved over its input student on all four sealed deployments. This informed choice is fixed before the two new seeds; it is not a fresh model-selection result.

initialization: Each independent body/seed arm starts identical body/window/noise RNG. Learned arms copy only the same 163 saved weights into fresh Architect history; seed=body seed, exploration=0. Canonical uses nt_tape_chuck_step.

acquisition.continuation: Force first action, then fifteen decisions by this checkpoint's current frozen weights with actual frozen-feedback history after every update.
acquisition.snapshot: Capture complete body/tape/gradients/moments/global and per-slot Chuck/Architect/RNG/train mode. Each branch begins at the same captured state; restore exact source before any fit or host update.
acquisition.measurements: Keep each branch's H16 loss on the next four fixed training windows separate from same-window feedback and fixed held-out loss. Arithmetic and comparisons execute in C.
acquisition.fit: living receives current measured H/B/P future-four losses; rotated assigns H/B/P = measured P/H/B. Frozen fits zero. Record measured and assigned values separately; do not silently relabel actions.
acquisition.failure: Retain and stop on nonfinite/incomplete measurement or restoration failure; fit no incomplete world. No numerical replay is used to repair damaged evidence.

objective: state-span-huber-v1: delta[a]=double(loss[HOLD])-loss[a]; scale=max(max_abs_finite_delta,1e-6*(abs(double(loss[HOLD]))+1)); target[a]=delta[a]/scale. Native mean three-head Huber delta1 with simultaneous update from pre-fit weights.

controls.frozen: Same life, observations, actual feedback and diagnostics; weights stay fixed. Compared with living, asks what acquisition changes.
controls.rotated: Same measurement and fitting budget, deliberately shifted credit. Compared with living, asks whether matching an executed action to its consequence matters. A negative-control arm is not a claim that living must win.
controls.canonical: Unchanged Chuck reference; no Architect decisions or diagnostic branches.
controls.probe_off: Repeat frozen without probes for all four body/seed pairs; every host transition, evaluation and final policy must match.
controls.resume: Repeat living with full Architect save/load after step256 for first seed1711 on each body. Actual body remains in process. All host/acquisition/evaluation events and final policy match uninterrupted execution; this does not claim out-of-process full-body resumption.

primary_comparisons: living versus frozen: acquired experience within one life
living versus rotated: correct action credit at matched fit budget
metrics: held-out curves and final paired deltas
pre/post-fit scores and selected action at an identical restored world
measured/assigned H16 outcomes and native target/objective
actual decreases of dampen versus saturated BRAKE selections
first floor entry and action sequence
full source/restored state identities and policy checkpoint hashes
elapsed seconds and peak RSS (descriptive, not a throughput benchmark)
gates: actual measured values reach the named action's target
deliberately wrong living credit is rejected
deterministic full trace and Architect save/load continuation
limits: Only two bodies and two new seeds, CPU F32. No GPU claim.
H16 continuation is frozen before the 32 fits; the newly fitted life may subsequently choose different actions. This remaining mismatch is recorded, not declared solved.
No recurrent capacity, extra action, DOE integration, new scalar penalty or hyperparameter sweep.
Held-out windows are reported, not fitting targets.
Success of the mechanism does not require beating canonical Chuck.
receipts: Commit protocol, runner, compact summaries and SHA-256 identities. Preserve raw traces, input corpora/tokens/vocab, source/config, initial/acquired/final lives and immutable byte anchors separately. No huge fork-body copies; deterministic source+inputs+seed+complete trace reconstruct the trajectory.

smoke.purpose: Development-only fixture and wiring. Never tune on1711/2357.
